svg.title: Every component of the gradient ∇θ ∈ ℝ^1007, followed through the same training run as the cover.
svg.desc: Time runs down the plate on a log(1 + step/8) scale (200 steps, AdamW, η 0.02 → 0.002 (warmup 20, cosine), β₂ 0.95, weight decay 0.01 on matrices, clip 1). Each path is one component of ∂ℓ/∂θᵢ (before clipping), averaged as Adam averages it (first moment, β₁ = 0.9, bias-corrected), placed horizontally at asinh(∂ℓ/∂θᵢ / g₀) with g₀ = 2.39e-2 (the initial root-mean-square component): linear near zero, logarithmic beyond. As the loss reaches its floor every component falls back to zero.
